title: How to Create Audio Driven Video with Claude MCP and Medux
description: Learn how to use Claude MCP and Medux to generate an avatar video by pairing a reusable avatar with an uploaded audio file, including setup, request fields,…
operation: Generate an avatar video by pairing a reusable avatar with an uploaded audio file.
prompt: Create a 7 second 1080P 16:9 talking video using avatar asset id {avatar asset id} and audio file id {audio file id}. Use model id talking-video-audio-standard.

fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.purpose: Requested output aspect ratio, such as 16:9 or 9:16.

fields.name: audio_file_id
fields.purpose: Provide the value described in the API reference.

fields.name: avatar_asset_id
fields.purpose: Reusable avatar asset ID owned by the current user or listed as an official public asset.

fields.name: clarity
fields.purpose: Requested output resolution label, such as 1080P or 2K.

fields.name: links
fields.purpose: Optional reference links submitted from the Playground form.

fields.name: model
fields.purpose: Generation model label or version selected in the Playground form.

fields.name: title
fields.purpose: Provide the value described in the API reference.
